title: Bill Belichick continues to say he's focused on UNC, not the NFL

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bill Belichick continues to say he's focused on UNC, not the NFL
sources.description: As should-be Hall of Fame head coach Bill Belichick prepares for his second season in college with an opening game in Ireland, he was asked if he ever sees himself returning to the NFL.
